rationale: This record is an introductory editorial overview for a journal special issue on intractable social conflict and processes of conflict institutionalization and deinstitutionalization. It has no connection to household or community water or sanitation services (failing Criterion 1 and Criterion 4), examines no water/sanitation legal or governance mechanisms (failing Criterion 2), and presents a special-issue overview rather than primary empirical research or a systematic review (failing Criterion 3). Primary exclusion code: E01 (wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both the narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2 because the record is a general special-issue introduction on intractable social conflict completely unrelated to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01) and lacks empirical primary data or systematic synthesis.

evidence_quotes.quote: Introduction: Intractable Conflict: New Perspectives on the Causes and Conditions for Change

This introduction presents an overview of the articles in this issue and draws from them to illustrate how the processes of institutionalization and deinstitutionalization relate to intractable conflicts.
